about: The name each budget line key carries on the budgets screen, taken from the line's own item label in the source table it comes from (Census state and local finance Table 1 for state and local lines, the OMB Historical Tables for federal ones). A line the project groups from several Census items is named by those items. The screen reads `name`; `source` says which item.
